hero.heading: We don't build pallets and we don't drive trucks.
hero.body: Which means AGL only works if the shops that build well and the carriers that run our lanes want to work with us. Two ways in.

cards.heading: Mills & shops →
cards.body: You build pallets, crates, or cut stock and want steady volume from a broker with no plant of its own.

cards.heading: Carriers →
cards.body: You run flatbed or dry van in the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic and want consistent regional freight.
